sentences.l2: 很久以前，人们写字很慢。
sentences.l1: A long time ago, people wrote slowly.

sentences.l2: 一个人写一本书，要用很多天。
sentences.l1: When one person wrote a book, it took many days.

sentences.l2: 后来，有人发明了印刷术。
人们可以用木头或石头做字模，然后印在纸上。
sentences.l1: People could make type blocks from wood or stone, and then print on paper.
This way, making a book was fast.

sentences.l2: 书籍越来越多，很多人可以读书。
sentences.l1: There were more and more books, and many people could read.

sentences.l2: 更多人学会了写字和看书。
sentences.l1: More people learned to write and read.
